script.title: SCHEDULING A FIRST PT SESSION
script.story_hook: Setting up a first physical therapy session.
script.intro_zh: 安排第一次物理治療與家練作業。
script.welcome_en: Hey friends, welcome back! Today we're at physical therapy.
script.welcome_zh: 嗨朋友們，歡迎回來！今天我們來到物理治療所。

script.outro_zh: 今天就到這裡！繼續聆聽，下次見。
script.practice_intro_en: Now listen and repeat each sentence after me.
script.practice_intro_zh: 現在跟著我，一句一句聆聽並跟讀。

script.youtube_title: 【💪物理治療初診🧘】「運動時會痛嗎？」復健所實用英文📋聽完就會問｜First PT Session English
script.youtube_title_en: “My First PT Session” — Scheduling a First Physical Therapy Visit
script.youtube_description:
第一次做物理治療，不知道怎麼用英文描述疼痛？這段超真實的復健所對話，幫你一次學好！跟著病人確認轉診單、描述下背疼痛、現場測試動作，到安排頻率與家練作業。整段 18 句美式日常英語，附繁體中文翻譯與 IPA 標音，後半段逐句跟讀，聽一遍就敢開口問。
#EnglishListening #ESL #LearnEnglish
訂閱我們的頻道，每天一集，讓英語變成你的直覺！
script.youtube_description_en:
First physical therapy visit and unsure how to describe pain in English? This super-realistic clinic chat gets you ready in one listen. Follow the patient checking the referral, describing lower-back pain, testing movement, and setting a schedule with home exercises — 18 lines of everyday American English with IPA. Repeat every line in the second half and speak up today.
#EnglishListening #ESL #LearnEnglish
Subscribe for a new episode every day!
script.youtube_title_ref: 【🎬沉浸式英文動畫】💪理療初診英文｜確認轉診單・描述疼痛・安排家練｜聽完就會問｜🌱A2 初級英文｜💡不用背，多聽就會用｜🎧聽力口說練習｜後段逐句跟讀
script.youtube_description_ref:
📌 影片簡介：
第一次做物理治療，卻不知道怎麼形容疼痛？
轉診單、頻率、家練作業，用英文要怎麼說？

這一集帶大家走進復健所，跟著病人從確認轉診單、描述下背疼痛、現場測試動作，到安排頻率與家練作業，全程都用自然的美式英語。

你會聽到：
📋 確認轉診單：例如「Did your doctor send a referral?」、「they faxed it, did you receive it」。
💪 描述疼痛：例如「My lower back aches, mostly when bending」、「since I moved boxes」。
🧘 安排與家練：例如「two visits per week」、「ten minutes of stretching nightly」。

後半段是逐句聽力加上跟讀練習 🎧，先聽一遍，再跟著一句一句唸，把整段對話變成自然的口語直覺。

🌱 適合 A2 初級英文學習者：不用死背，跟著情境反覆聽，自然就會用。

看完記得實戰一次，原來理療問診可以這麼簡單！

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Hello, I'm here for my first PT session.
dialogue.phonetic: /hɛˈloʊ aɪm hɪr fɔr maɪ fɜrst pi ti ˈsɛʃən/
dialogue.zh: 你好，我來做第一次物理治療。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Welcome! Did your doctor send a referral?
dialogue.phonetic: /ˈwɛlkəm dɪd jɔr ˈdɑktər sɛnd ə rɪˈfɜrəl/
dialogue.zh: 歡迎！你的醫生有轉診單嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Yes, they faxed it, did you receive it?
dialogue.phonetic: /jɛs ðeɪ fækst ɪt dɪd ju rɪˈsiv ɪt/
dialogue.zh: 有，他們傳真了，你有收到嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Got it, so let's talk about your pain.
dialogue.phonetic: /ɡɑt ɪt soʊ lɛts tɔk əˈbaʊt jɔr peɪn/
dialogue.zh: 收到了，那我們來談你的疼痛。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: My lower back aches, mostly when bending.
dialogue.phonetic: /maɪ ˈloʊər bæk eɪks ˈmoʊstli wɛn ˈbɛndɪŋ/
dialogue.zh: 我下背會痠，尤其彎身時。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: How long has this been bothering you?
dialogue.phonetic: /haʊ lɔŋ hæz ðɪs bɪn ˈbɑðərɪŋ ju/
dialogue.zh: 這種情況困擾你多久了？

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: About three weeks, since I moved boxes.
dialogue.phonetic: /əˈbaʊt θri wikz sɪns aɪ muːvd bɑksɪz/
dialogue.zh: 大約三週了，自從我搬了箱子。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Okay, can you bend slowly for me?
dialogue.phonetic: /oʊˈkeɪ kæn ju bɛnd ˈsloʊli fɔr mi/
dialogue.zh: 好，你能慢慢彎一下給我看看嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Like this? Ouch, yeah that's the spot.
dialogue.phonetic: /laɪk ðɪs aʊtʃ jɛ ðæts ðə spɑt/
dialogue.zh: 像這樣？哎唷，對，就是那裡。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: I see, your muscles are quite tight.
dialogue.phonetic: /aɪ si jɔr ˈmʌsəlz ɑr kwaɪt taɪt/
dialogue.zh: 我了解了，你的肌肉相當緊繃。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Can you fix that today, hopefully?
dialogue.zh: 今天能改善嗎，我希望可以？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: We'll start gentle, two visits per week.
dialogue.phonetic: /wil stɑrt ˈdʒɛntəl tu ˈvɪzɪts pɜr wik/
dialogue.zh: 我們會溫和開始，每週兩次。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Sounds fair. Will it hurt during exercises?
dialogue.phonetic: /saʊndz fɛr wɪl ɪt hɜrt ˈdʊrɪŋ ˈɛksərsaɪz/
dialogue.zh: 聽起來公平。運動時會痛嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Some stretch, but never sharp pain.
dialogue.zh: 有一點拉伸感，但不會刺痛。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Okay good. Any homework between sessions?
dialogue.zh: 好，那兩次治療之間有作業嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Yes, ten minutes of stretching nightly.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: I can do that, thank you for this.
dialogue.phonetic: /aɪ kæn du ðæt θæŋk ju fɔr ðɪs/
dialogue.zh: 我做得到，謝謝你這一切。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Great! Let's book your next time now.
dialogue.phonetic: /ɡreɪt lɛts bʊk jɔr nɛkst taɪm naʊ/
dialogue.zh: 太好了！我們現在來排下次時間。
